conventions: Each gpt-5.6-luna run copies one fixture into run-local outputs/gtm-home, never accesses ~/.gtm, records complete user-facing output in transcript.md, and leaves copied GTM context and Git unchanged. No-skill arms forbid all skills.

evals.prompt: My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Gridline is active at root. Score Alex Morgan at ForgeOne with our existing lead-scoring rubric. Supplied persona_label is `revenue-operations-leader`, already validated; do not re-segment. Supplied component ratings: persona fit `exact`; role authority `champion`; need/timing `active`; engagement `direct`. Show mappings, addition, any cap, final band, confidence, needs_review, positives, risks, recommended action, reasoning, provenance, and open questions. Do not browse, enrich, research the person, define a rubric, write files, or change external systems.
evals.expected_output: Uses root lead-scoring.md and returns 40 + 20 + 20 + 15 = 95, hot, high confidence, needs_review false, with complete response-only metadata.

evals.prompt:
My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Veridian is active at root. Score and rank these already-segmented leads with the existing lead-scoring rubric; do not browse, enrich, research people, re-segment, define a rubric, or write files.

| lead | company | title | persona_label | persona fit | role authority | need/timing | engagement |
| Nina Karlsson | NordPay | Head of Fraud Operations | fraud-operations-leader | exact | champion | active | direct |
| Omar Haddad | Beacon Bank | Chief Compliance Officer | compliance-executive | exact | economic | emerging | multi-signal |
| Owen Hart | Hart Advisory | Fraud Advisor | no-match | no-match | practitioner | active | direct |
| Priya Shah | Kestrel | VP Risk | compliance-executive | exact | not supplied | emerging | single |

Start with band distribution, average final score, low-confidence and review-needed counts, common risks, and common open questions. Then rank every lead with company, title, persona label, component mappings, raw/final score, cap, band, confidence, needs_review, positives, risks, action, reasoning, provenance, and open questions.
